authored: Project-authored interpretation rules (2026-10-23). Statements describe tendencies suggested by self-report, not fixed traits, diagnoses or abilities. Bands are not population norms.

rules.statement: I tend to think out loud and get energy from discussion.
rules.softened: I sometimes think out loud and can get energy from discussion.
rules.agent_tip: Engage conversationally: propose ideas, invite reactions and think through options together.

rules.statement: I tend to prefer reflecting quietly before discussing.
rules.softened: I sometimes prefer to reflect before discussing.
rules.agent_tip: Give me written material I can read and think about; avoid rapid back-and-forth questions.

rules.statement: I tend to value harmony and consider how others are affected.
rules.softened: I often consider how others are affected.
rules.agent_tip: When drafting messages to people, keep them considerate; when reviewing my decisions, still name the hard trade-offs.

rules.statement: I tend to be sceptical and comfortable challenging others.
rules.softened: I can be sceptical and willing to challenge others.
rules.agent_tip: Support claims with evidence; I am more convinced by reasons than by reassurance.

rules.statement: I tend to be organised, thorough and reliable about follow-through.
rules.softened: I am often organised and thorough.
rules.agent_tip: Match my thoroughness: close loops, list remaining TODOs and do not leave work half-finished.

rules.statement: I tend to prefer flexibility over plans and may leave loose ends.
rules.softened: I sometimes prefer flexibility and may leave loose ends.
rules.agent_tip: At the end of a task, list loose ends and propose the next concrete step.

rules.statement: I tend to feel pressure and setbacks strongly.
rules.softened: Pressure and setbacks sometimes weigh on me.
rules.agent_tip: When something breaks, lead with a calm summary and a concrete recovery plan before details.

rules.statement: I tend to stay calm under pressure.
rules.softened: I often stay calm under pressure.
rules.agent_tip: Do not soften bad news; state problems plainly and move to options.

rules.statement: I tend to enjoy new ideas, abstraction and unconventional approaches.
rules.softened: I often enjoy new ideas and abstraction.
rules.agent_tip: Offer alternative approaches and the underlying concepts, not only the conventional fix.

rules.statement: I tend to prefer proven, practical approaches over novelty.
rules.softened: I often prefer proven, practical approaches.
rules.agent_tip: Prefer established tools and patterns; justify anything new with concrete benefits.

rules.statement: I tend to jump into action before thinking everything through.
rules.softened: I sometimes act before thinking everything through.
rules.agent_tip: Before large or irreversible changes, pause and list risks in one short paragraph.

rules.statement: I tend to think carefully before acting.
rules.softened: I often think carefully before acting.
rules.agent_tip: Surface risks and edge cases early; I prefer to decide with them in view.

rules.statement: Getting started on tasks can be hard for me.
rules.softened: Getting started on tasks is sometimes hard for me.
rules.agent_tip: Break work into a small first step I can finish quickly.

rules.statement: Tidiness and order are not a natural priority for me.
rules.softened: Tidiness and order are not always a priority for me.
rules.agent_tip: Keep files, names and structure tidy without being asked, and point out clutter worth cleaning.

rules.statement: I tend to take charge and lead.
rules.softened: I often take charge.
rules.agent_tip: Give me decision-ready summaries with a recommendation, not open-ended lists.

rules.statement: I tend to wait for others to set direction.
rules.softened: I sometimes wait for others to set direction.
rules.agent_tip: When I hesitate between options, recommend one clearly and explain why.

rules.statement: I tend to engage readily in confrontation.
rules.softened: I sometimes engage readily in confrontation.
rules.agent_tip: When I draft tense messages, suggest a calmer version alongside mine.

rules.statement: Under heavy pressure I can feel overwhelmed.
rules.softened: Under heavy pressure I sometimes feel overwhelmed.
rules.agent_tip: In busy moments, help me prioritise: name the one thing to do next.

rules.statement: I tend to enjoy challenging, theoretical material.
rules.softened: I often enjoy challenging material.
rules.agent_tip: Do not oversimplify; reference the underlying theory when it helps.

rules.statement: I tend to push myself to do more than expected.
rules.softened: I often push myself to do more than expected.
rules.agent_tip: Point out when extra polish no longer pays off, so effort goes where it matters.

rules.statement: I tend to value fairness and sincerity over status.
rules.softened: I often value fairness and sincerity.
rules.agent_tip: Be transparent about limitations and uncertainty; never overstate results.

rules.statement: Status and recognition tend to matter to me.
rules.softened: Status and recognition sometimes matter to me.
rules.agent_tip: When I make claims about results, help me check that they are fully supported.

rules.statement: I tend to trust my ability to handle difficult or unexpected problems.
rules.softened: I often trust my ability to handle difficult problems.
rules.agent_tip: Hand me hard problems straight; skip reassurance and get to the substance.

rules.statement: I tend to doubt whether I can handle unexpected problems.
rules.softened: I sometimes doubt whether I can handle unexpected problems.
rules.agent_tip: Break hard problems into steps and point out progress already made.

rules.statement: I tend to enjoy effortful thinking and complex problems.
rules.softened: I often enjoy complex problems.
rules.agent_tip: Share the reasoning behind non-obvious solutions; I enjoy understanding why.

rules.statement: I tend to prefer clear, practical answers over long deliberation.
rules.softened: I often prefer clear, practical answers.
rules.agent_tip: Give the practical answer first and keep theory optional.

rules.statement: In work situations I tend to decide quickly and adjust later.
rules.softened: In work situations I often decide quickly.
rules.agent_tip: Move fast with me, but flag decisions that are expensive to reverse.

rules.statement: In work situations I tend to gather information before deciding.
rules.softened: In work situations I often gather information first.
rules.agent_tip: Give me the key facts and open questions before recommending; tell me when more research would not change the answer.

rules.statement: I tend to accept risk to move forward.
rules.softened: I sometimes accept risk to move forward.
rules.agent_tip: Name the worst realistic outcome of risky choices in one line, then help me proceed.

rules.statement: I tend to favour safe, reversible options.
rules.softened: I often favour safe options.
rules.agent_tip: Prefer reversible changes, feature flags and rollback plans.

rules.statement: I tend to address issues head-on and say things plainly.
rules.softened: I often address issues plainly.
rules.agent_tip: Be equally direct with me: state problems plainly without hedging.

rules.statement: I tend to avoid raising uncomfortable issues directly.
rules.softened: I sometimes avoid raising uncomfortable issues directly.
rules.agent_tip: When I draft messages that hint at a problem, suggest a clearer, still respectful wording.

rules.statement: In disagreements I tend to hold my position.
rules.softened: In disagreements I often hold my position.
rules.agent_tip: If you think I am wrong, argue with evidence; I respond to well-made counterarguments.

rules.statement: In disagreements I tend to accommodate others.
rules.softened: In disagreements I sometimes accommodate others.
rules.agent_tip: When I give way on something important, ask whether I really agree or should push back.

rules.statement: I tend to involve others and seek agreement.
rules.softened: I often involve others.
rules.agent_tip: Suggest who else should review or weigh in on decisions.

rules.statement: I tend to work independently and decide on my own.
rules.softened: I often work independently.
rules.agent_tip: Point out when a decision affects others enough that they should be consulted.

rules.statement: I tend to take problems on personally and see them through.
rules.softened: I often take problems on personally.
rules.agent_tip: Help me notice when delegating would be better than doing it myself.

rules.statement: I tend to route problems to the right owner rather than fix them myself.
rules.softened: I often route problems to the right owner.
rules.agent_tip: When drafting hand-offs, make them complete and actionable for the receiving owner.

rules.statement: I tend to rely on plans, processes and written agreements.
rules.softened: I often rely on plans and processes.
rules.agent_tip: Structure work as explicit plans and checklists.

rules.statement: I tend to improvise and adapt as I go.
rules.softened: I often adapt as I go.
rules.agent_tip: Keep plans lightweight and easy to change; avoid heavy process.

rules.statement: As a leader I may delay difficult conversations.
rules.softened: As a leader I sometimes delay difficult conversations.
rules.agent_tip: When I prepare 1:1s or feedback, help me state the core message in the first two sentences.

rules.statement: In product decisions I may commit before evidence is in.
rules.softened: In product decisions I sometimes commit early.
rules.agent_tip: When I plan a launch or roadmap change, ask what evidence would change my mind.
